answers.how: The white-shirted person moves about 166 pixels/s, versus 128 pixels/s for the black-shirted person. Their speed ratio gives 1.30 m/s.
At 1.0 s, the person centers are approximately 97 pixels apart. Using 128 pixels per meter gives 0.76 m.
At 2.0 s, the person centers are approximately 119 pixels apart. Using 128 pixels per meter gives 0.93 m.
